transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I just can’t make myself do anything anymore. I sit in my room in the same clothes, and I don’t knit or journal or go walking like I used to. My mom asks what’s wrong, but I barely have the energy to answer her.
About how long have you been feeling this way?
Since I started the community-college program, so... about two years and a couple months now.
During these past two years, have there been any periods where you felt back to your normal self for more than a couple of months?
No. It’s been pretty constant since I started that program—about two years and two months. I haven’t really felt like my normal self again for any long stretch.
Have you ever had a time when you felt unusually energetic, wired, or full of energy, with much less need for sleep?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had times where I felt wired or like I didn’t need sleep.
Before this started about two years ago, had you ever experienced any other periods in your life when you felt deeply depressed?
I’m not really sure. I can’t think of a specific time before then that was like that.
How has your sleep been during this time?
I’m not sure how to describe it. What do you mean—like whether I’m sleeping enough, or if it’s hard to fall asleep?
Have you been having trouble falling asleep or waking up during the night?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t paid much attention to whether I’m waking up during the night or anything.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite during this time?
I don’t think I’ve noticed any big change in my appetite. I haven’t really been keeping track of it, though.
Have you been feeling hopeless about the future?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really thought about the future that much lately.
How have you been feeling about yourself lately, in terms of your self-esteem or self-worth?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really been thinking about myself in that way lately.
Have you had trouble concentrating or making everyday decisions?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything specific with that.
Have you found yourself sleeping much more than usual, or spending a lot more time in bed sleeping?
I don’t think so. My sleep has been pretty normal, as far as I can tell.
Have you been feeling down, sad, or empty most days during this time?
I’m not sure. I don’t think I’ve really been feeling sad most days, but I haven’t paid much attention to it.
Do you drink alcohol or use any recreational drugs?
I’m not sure what counts as recreational drugs. I don’t really know.
Do you drink any alcohol, such as beer, wine, or liquor?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think I drink alcohol, but I can’t say for certain.
